lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-luminance nodes are arranged in approximately six distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with inter-node spacing exhibiting high spatial regularity across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high luminance (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of faint, small high-luminance blobs is visible across the primary silhouette of the dorsal fin, concentrated mainly towards the posterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high concentration of small, densely packed high-luminance spots, which are significantly smaller and more numerous per unit area than those on the main flank.
